item.title: Goh family buys 18 Orchard Shopping Centre units for $73 mil as owners explore collective sale
item.description: The Goh family behind lifestyle products retailer Ossia International, has acquired a portfolio of 18 retail units at Orchard Shopping Centre for $73 million. The units occupy a combined strata area of 8,934 sq ft, translating to $8,171 psf. Located on the first two storeys of the retail podium of the nine-storey freehold commercial building at the corner of Orchard Road and Grange Road, they represent 18% of the strata area and 23.5% of the total share value. item.title: Japan Hotel REIT raises JPY62 billion to acquire Hyatt Regency Tokyo
item.description: Tokyo-listed Japan Hotel REIT, sponsored by Singapore-based real estate investment manager SC Capital Partners, has completed a JPY62 billion ($503 million) global equity raise to acquire Hyatt Regency Tokyo, a landmark hotel in Shinjuku. The proceeds will be used mainly to fund the acquisition, which gives Japan Hotel REIT a rare strategic opportunity to secure an iconic Tokyo hotel at a “compelling” entry price that is 20% below appraisal value, SC Capital said in a March 5 release. item.title: Mapletree sells US logistics portfolio for US$575 mil, acquires logistics facility in the Netherlands
item.description: Temasek-owned Mapletree Investments announced that it has sold a US industrial portfolio of about 4.43 million sq ft to EQT Real Estate for US$575 million. The transaction marks Mapletree’s fourth US warehouse portfolio divestment, following a total of US$691.1 million in logistics asset sales completed in 2025. Richard Prokup, CEO for the US at Mapletree, says the divestment reflects the execution of Mapletree’s closed-end fund strategy and highlights the strength of its US industrial platform.
